Team — quick summary and recommendation (please advise):

Summary:
- Invoice: INV-2027-042 reissued zero-VAT on 23 Apr per customer request.
- Outstanding: USD 42,500 (Aging = 16 days past original due date).
- Customer: Ivybridge Health — stated they will provide PO-65421 and VAT ID; payment not yet received.

Risk: Ivybridge has been responsive but not provided the tax ID or payment date. Given this is a mid-size strategic account with an active integration, I recommend a soft lock on non-critical provisioning (no new trial instances or bursts) and pause on onboarding work until we have a confirmed payment date or partial payment. This is a reversible measure — we should communicate clearly before taking it.

Proposed next steps:
1) Finance (Monica) to send a firm 7-day payment reminder with escalation language (include aging and reissued invoice).
2) Sales (Marcus) to pause non-urgent provisioning and offer to coordinate with their procurement to expedite PO.
3) If no response in 7 days, escalate to credit committee for approval of service restrictions or collection options. (I can present the account at the credit committee.)
4) Legal/Tax to advise if invoicing to Ivybridge AG or issuing reverse charge has any downstream accounting implications (I've looped Rachel for VAT guidance).

Attachments: ivybridge-aging-202704.xlsx

Please reply with approval or alternative suggestions.

Thanks,
